messages.subject: MSPE and predictive distribution in INLA
parts:
I havent seen any examples on INLA of computing a predictive distribution and then using predictions to provide
predictive residuals or MSPE measures.  The leave one out diagnostics of CPO and PIT are available.
Does anyone have code to do MSPE on INLA?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] MSPE and predictive distribution in INLA
parts:
As mentioned by Daniel, the plain Monte Carlo (not MCMC) approach provided by inla.posterior.sample is the most general solution. Depending on the model, that can be made more efficient by doing direct calculations of the data level uncertainty. However, if all you care about are point predictions of the (transformed) linear predictor (and to some degree if you want to calculate metrics using the posterior uncertainty as well), you could simply use the fitted.values output to obtain the needed information to calculate residuals for out-of-sample data, if that's what you alluded to.

More details about precisely it is you want to compute are needed to give more precise answers.

Finn
